candidates.title: The Ice Cream That Melted Only on One Side
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered one row of festival ice cream melted while the neighboring tubs stayed frozen before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they turned down the cooler thermostat but the same row kept softening; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the cooler lid had a warped seal that let warm air enter one corner; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they replaced the seal and checked every tub before serving, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Orchard With No Visitors
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the orchard flowers bloomed but the pollinating insects never arrived before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they planted brighter flowers nearby but the orchard remained empty; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a protective mesh installed during the winter still blocked insects from entering; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they opened the appropriate mesh panels and restored safe access for pollinators, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Song Nobody Could Finish
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the school band and choir kept landing on different notes at the finale before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they rehearsed each section separately but the final chord still clashed; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the brass players had been given a score transposed for a different instrument; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they printed the correct parts and rehearsed the ending with everyone together, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
